social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Team Pillbert has dropped quarterback Geno Smith, who put up 18 points in his one week of work. Alan's QB plans for the week ahead are worth watching.

social.author: Bayou Brian
social.text: Philly cutting a quarterback who just gave him 18 points is a bold way to start a Tuesday. Hope there's a plan, because I can't see it.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Geno Smith is out on the wire and Alan is the one who put him there. Habib is being handed a head start in this matchup and we'll take it.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Habibsters sit at 43% against Team Pillbert, so a quarterback shuffle on Alan's side matters. Dropping 18 points of production is a risk I'd want explained.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The fumblers picked up two running backs off waivers, Tony Pollard and Jonah Coleman. Derrick Henry is already on the roster, so this looks like depth, and it's worth noting Randy rarely makes moves at all.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Ghostu-Spider SZN is at 38% against No Banner only HULK, and swapping in the Broncos D/ST and a new kicker is the kind of small edge Zoe needs. Smart use of the free agent pool.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Sonny cut Marvin Harrison Jr. for the Buccaneers D/ST and I LOVE it. Defense wins weeks, mark it down, LOCK.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Keenan Allen is a Habibster and Chris Boswell is gone. Habib is out here shuffling the deck before kickoff against Philly, and honestly we need it.
